name: model_op_compressor
description: Compressor: paged KV/gate projection with softmax-weighted group compression, RMSNorm and RoPE (FlagGems-vllm PR #789, compressor). x is [total_tokens, hidden] with cu_seqlens [batch+1] int32, or [batch, seq_len, hidden] for the rank-3 form; wkv and wgate are [coff*head_dim, hidden]; state_cache [state_blocks, block_size, 2*coff*head_dim] float32 is a paged cache holding the kv projection in the first half and the gate projection plus positional embedding ape [cmp_ratio, coff*head_dim] in the second; norm_weight [head_dim]; rope_sin and rope_cos [rope_rows, rope_head_dim]; state_block_table [batch, max_blocks] int32 maps positions to cache blocks with 0 and out-of-range meaning absent; start_pos [batch] int32 is each request's starting position. Every token's projections are scattered into state_cache, then each group of cmp_ratio positions is reduced by a softmax over the cached gate rows, RMS-normalized with norm_eps, scaled by norm_weight, and rotated by RoPE (rotary_mode 2 is the interleaved even/odd form, 1 the half-split form). Returns the compressed output; state_cache is mutated in place. Output rows beyond the valid compressed-group count stay zero.
